mapper.insert: INSERT INTO carousel (id, title, pictureLogic, picturePath, linkUrl, linkTarget, sort, enabled, objectFit, createTime) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{pictureLogic}, #{picturePath}, #{linkUrl}, #{linkTarget}, #{sort}, #{enabled}, #{objectFit}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, pictureLogic, picturePath, linkUrl, linkTarget, sort, enabled, objectFit, createTime FROM carousel ORDER BY sort ASC
SELECT id, title, pictureLogic, picturePath, linkUrl, linkTarget, sort, enabled, objectFit, createTime FROM carousel WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC
SELECT id, title, pictureLogic, picturePath, linkUrl, linkTarget, sort, enabled, objectFit, createTime FROM carousel ORDER BY sort ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
